notes.title: OFFICIAL PUBLISHER ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes: [h1][b]Hello Mercenaries![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We’re proud to announce that [b]Doomies (Damikira) [/b]is officially joining forces with indie.io![/p][p][/p][p]We started working on this project in April of 2023, and it was the start of our studio and in general the start of a great adventure for us! [b]Doomies[/b] has, and always will be a very important project for us.[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/p][p][/p][p]We chose to work with indie.io since they have a great track record with helping other indie games reach more players.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the amazing games being published by indie.io![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to wishlist our game, and join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/BJzv9qjWCV"]Discord[/url] community![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446700/Doomies_Damikira/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]As always, I want to thank our community for always being with us, and supporting us through the development of our games![/p][p][b]-The Brain-dead Rabbit Games team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Damikira Update - v1.3.1 (LAST UPDATE)
notes.notes:
A new update has been released for Damikira (v1.3.1)

This update is here to just fix some things that have been bothering me personally. This is by the way the last update for Damikira, after this we will drop support for the game entirely, and move to develop other new games.

* Buffed Emily's default gun (now shoots faster, and deals way more damage)
* Added an option to bring back the old name of the game
* Added back the discord button for joining the discord server
* Fixed a small collision bug in one of the levels of the game
* During a multiplayer match, Screen shake and camera recoil are automatically disabled to avoid discomfort

As I said, this is the last update the game will receive, I know this is sad news for many of you, after all, the Damikira community is one that, while small, definitely had some passion towards the game. But it is time to move on and focus on new things, we're so glad of the community we have created around the game, and we hope we deliver with our newer games.

Thanks for playing, take care.
-Ricardo

notes.title: DAMIKIRA (Formerly Doomies) is finally available on all consoles!
notes.notes:
Damikira has been released on all major consoles.

Get in on [b]Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and S and Playstation 4 and 5[/b]!
[url=https://www.eastasiasoft.com/games/Damikira]MORE INFORMATION AND STORE LINKS HERE[/url]

[b]GAME SUMMARY[/b]

"What do you get when you combine frenetic arcade-style shooting, tons of guns and violence, a sprinkle of dark humor and a grappling hook? It’s Damikira, an action-packed platformer that’s easy to play but tough to master! Grab a firearm and blast through side-scrolling stages as you face hordes of costumed enemies, challenge online leaderboards, upgrade your arsenal and discover hidden mechanics to stack the deck in your favor!

Damikira features a variety of playable characters, each with their own fully voiced one-liners and fluid pixel art animations. Enjoy a heavy metal soundtrack and punchy gun sounds that add to the intensity and satisfaction of the ensuing mayhem. With plenty of weapons to unlock, missions to clear and gritty stages to explore, there’s unlimited replay value to keep you coming back for one more bloodbath!"

notes.title: Update - 1.3 (NEW VOICE ACTOR FOR ERIC)

A new update has been released for Damikira (v1.3)

* Buffed the Hunting-Rifle (finally)
* Buffed the BFR-3000

The old quotes made by Azzy have not been removed, but now you can choose another voice for him if you wanna!

The new voice is from my very good friend: Duke!

By the way, I know the last updates have been really small lately, just want to tell you that we've been waiting on the release of Damikira for consoles, after that we will release bigger ones! Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Update - 1.2.7
notes.notes:
A new patch for Doomies (Damikira) has been released

1.- Changed the game's brand from "Doomies" to "Damikira" to match the name of the upcoming console version (more details below of why this change was made)
2.- Removed third male hurt sound, that sounded too much like "Minecraft's beta hurt sound" (It's actually the same sound, its just that the sound is actually royalty free, so no worries)

[b]Now, I want to explain a bit of why the game is receiving a name change...[/b]

As you may know, Doomies (now Damikira), is gonna be available very soon (October 2024) on consoles, the thing is, without giving too much details, Doomies is actually a brand that is no longer ours, since someone has actually registered the brand for something that has nothing to do with our game. Which is fine, Ricardo never registered the brand unfortunately, since he thought there wasn't a need for that, but that backfired, and so now we needed to change the name of our game for consoles if we wanted to release it there. And of course, we don't want to have two different names for what is pretty much the same game.

Hope you understand this change.

notes.title: Winds of change
notes.notes:
Hello! It's been a while since I release a big announcement, but I think this Is worth having that big announcement...

For most of my career as a GameDev, I've been working alone, sure, many times I had help of others. But it was minimum, or it came with a price of course. But from now on, "Brain-dead Rabbit", or as now it's called "Brian-dead Rabbit Games", will be it's own full studio!

For now, we're just 3 people making games, and of course, we will continue with the development of this game, as a team!

We also started the development of other projects, which we're really anxious to show once they're ready to be shown!

If you want, please consider following us in our new twitter page: [url=]https://twitter.com/bdr_games_[/url]

You can access to it by right clicking on the game, going to properties, betas, and selecting the beta branch called "beta-preview", when doing that the game will update automatically.

Here's a list of the additions:

[list]

notes.title: Doomies - Build 20 | Small patch
notes.notes:
I've updated a little bit the behavior and stats of the enemies so they seem a little bit more fair to play against

[b]1.-[/b] Now there's a cap on how much faster the enemies can shoot when the difficulty increases

[b]2.-[/b] The "chainsaw pig", or "the butcher" as i like to call him, now doesn't do damage to you when it's in the headless state, before it could still damage you because he still had the chainsaw in his hands... I don't know why I released the game with that mechanic to be honest, I already knew it sucked.

[b]3.-[/b] In the mission of rescuing hostages, now you just have to rescue 2 instead of 3, to complete the mission

Hope these changes help you to enjoy the game a little bit more!
